overview.Name: Urban Edge Properties
overview.Description: Urban Edge Properties is a NYSE listed real estate investment trust focused on owning, managing, acquiring, developing, and redeveloping retail real estate. Specifically in urban communities, primarily in the Washington, D.C. to Boston corridor. Urban Edge owns 73 properties totaling 17.2 million square feet of gross leasable area. Urban Edge Properties was incorporated in 2014 and is based in New York, United States.
